text:
Columbus arrives in Philadelphia riding Adam Fantilli's power-play one-timer, which beat Vegas in overtime on Saturday, but the Blue Jackets are 2-3-0 in their last five and have been outscored 16-9 in that stretch. This is game one of a three-game road trip. The Flyers lost 5-4 to Anaheim after blowing a two-goal lead, and they're playing without Travis Konecny, Owen Tippett, Rasmus Ristolainen and Cam York. With Konecny out, Porter Martone has moved onto a line with Christian Dvorak and Matvei Michkov.

Our numbers lean Columbus on shot quality. At five on five, the Blue Jackets have taken 48% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) in their games, against 38% for Philadelphia, and we project it close: 3.02 expected goals for CBJ, 2.81 for PHI. The Flyers take 4.2 penalties a game, which keeps handing opponents power plays. In net, projected starter Dan Vladar (PHI) is at +1.9 goals saved above expected this season, while Jet Greaves (CBJ) is at -0.5. Last season both were well in the black, Greaves at +15.0 and Vladar at +12.7.

Michkov has 9 points in his last ten games and is 28% to score tonight, level with Trevor Zegras, who is on a four-game point streak. Fantilli is 29% to score and 56% for a point. Our under-the-radar pick is Cole Sillinger, a third-liner whose shots have been dangerous, at 16% to score and 36% for a point. Both are players to watch, not locks.
